name: How long does a typical bathroom tile update take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom tile update take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom tile update depends on the project's scope, including the bathroom size, the complexity of the tile design, and the type of tiles selected. A small bathroom floor or shower retiling might take 2-4 days, while a complete bathroom overhaul involving demolition, new tile installation, and surface preparation could range from 1 to 2 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom tile update can take from a few days for small areas to 1-2 weeks for a complete overhaul.
